title: 上海景点资料 · Shanghai/Zhabei
text:
资料城市：上海。本文是历史开放景点资料，不提供实时开放时间或价格；出行前需要核实。

Shanghai Railway Museum
Museum about trains and railways in China. Closed on Sundays and Mondays.

Shanghai Circus World
Known, among other things, for fine acrobatic shows and is on many tour group itineraries.
freshness: 历史数据快照，已知lastEdit至2016；采集时间不等于更新时间。仅作景点背景参考，出行细节需向官方核实。
